title: Slime Heroes
description:
Journey with your fellow slimes to save the ancient guardians from a mysterious corruption taking over the land. On your own or with a friend through couch and online co-op, explore a whimsical world filled with secret passageways, challenging puzzles and battle dungeons, and forgotten treasures. Consume special gems and dynamically combine them to create unique magical skills. Level up and fight back against the corrupted minions and terrifying bosses to restore the land.

Make Your Slime Your OwnGive your slime its own personality in the character creator — choose its eyes, smile, and colors!

Dynamic AbilitiesCollect and consume gems dropped from defeated enemies and dynamically combine them with thousands of combinations to discover new magical attacks that suit your playstyle at any time. 

Visit Puzzle and Battle DungeonsPut your skills to the test in puzzle and battle dungeons found throughout the map, and gain helpful rewards and items to help your slime along their journey.

Challenge A Variety of BossesEach area has its own challenging boss to defeat. Choose the right build and learn their evolving attack patterns. Once defeated, visit the boss dungeons to challenge them again for helpful rewards. 

Gain Weapons and GearFrom swords to hammers to spears and discs, gain new weapons to aid you on your journey. Search hidden areas and help the world’s inhabitants to collect hats with helpful stat buffs that will keep you fashionable and ready for battle.

Play With FriendsGo it alone or jump into a friend’s game at any time through couch, online, or remote play co-op. Use the shared loot system to your advantage to create complementary abilities.

Travel Across an Expansive WorldExplore six distinct regions and meet their guardians. Discover secret passageways and hidden areas. Return to previously explored areas to find even more secrets!
description_short: Play as the last slime tasked with saving their home in this cute 3D action-adventure slimes-like! Customize your slime, play alone or with a friend, collect weapons and gear, battle challenging enemies and bosses, gain skills, and combine them to create your own abilities to suit your playstyle!
